current.title: True Home is the intermediate station
current.body: The operator selected the October 26 revised Hamilton route as the default for Lacry. Hamilton is now X144.50 Y-350.68 Z61.22 Rz-3.00; the old X195.34 Y-360.31 Z38.61 endpoint is historical. Preserve the exact accepted three-target route at speed137 in both directions: Home X289.97 Y62.63 Z248.02 Rz-3.88; transit X215.74 Y-249 Z212 Rz-0.94; hover X195.88 Y-357.36 Z212 Rz-1.90; Hamilton. Hamilton to Squid means Hamilton -> true Home -> Squid; reverse means Squid -> true Home -> Hamilton. Both travel trials completed and were operator-accepted (8.050 and8.230 seconds). Production station recognition and handling use the revised pose. Travel evidence does not establish payload or commission pickup/release at the new position: retain existing Hamilton inspection checkpoints, open5/close3.7, lift5mm at speed5. Squid approach/handling are unchanged. Current host evidence and clearance checks remain authoritative; memory never authorizes a new movement.
current.source: Operator confirmed 2026-10-17; lacry_backend.py and recorded route files

current.title: Station handling: Squid accepted; Hamilton supervised trials available
current.body: Both stations now have executable host-owned drop-off/retrieval via plan_station_handling(station,release/pickup), or squid_dropoff/squid_retrieve/hamilton_dropoff/hamilton_retrieve. Both start and finish true Home. Travel137, openE1=5 at speed5 for drop-off, closeE1=3.7 at speed5 for retrieval, lift5mm at speed5, then return Home. Squid handling has accepted loaded evidence. The revised October26 Hamilton travel passed both directions with operator acceptance; payload was not recorded; local release/pickup is a SUPERVISED TRIAL, not commissioned loaded handling. Current Hamilton seated X144.50 Y-350.68 Z61.22 Rz-3.00, liftedZ66.22. Old-location handling history does not validate the new local handoff. Pause at arrival for plate support/alignment inspection before jaw motion; pause after lift for plate-left-flat or secure-hold inspection before departure. Buttons Leave plate at Hamilton and Retrieve plate from Hamilton are loaded in Researcher UI. First plan confirmation uses chat Yes; inspections use Looks right-continue/Reject. Require already-running Auto; never restart loaded gripper. Drop-off starts Home holding at3.7; retrieval starts Home empty at5. No disk calibration at instrument stations. No automatic dispensing/imaging or inferred completion; require explicit operator completion or hypothetical-test authorization. Multi-cycle instrument experiments remain blocked until instrument integration/delivery validation.83 focused tests and browser checks pass; no physical Hamilton handling trial during implementation. Shared executor operator_ui/squid_handling.py; Hamilton geometry/evidence operator_ui/hamilton_handling.py. All proposals/steps/inspections/jaw reports/travel samples logged to existing JSONL audit.

current.title: Hamilton near-zero J1: successful empty-gripper round trip
current.body: 2026-10-20: Operator requested J1 zero. Active Hamilton endpoint X195.34 Y-360.31 Z38.61 Rz-1.90 is rounded upward to0.01mm Cartesian queue resolution; predicted/observed J1 about+0.01mm. Existing0..400mm limit unchanged. After operator removed plate and confirmed route/E-stop, Lacry executed current Hamilton->true Home->Hamilton at speed137. Home reached X289.970 Y62.630 Z248.021; final Hamilton X195.338 Y-360.310 Z38.609 Rz-1.900, J1+0.00994. No controller errors during travel; durations28.12s/27.93s including dispatch/polling. Full record operator_ui/reports/hamilton/zero_roundtrip_20261020T113048Z.json. Successful EMPTY-gripper trial only; loaded placement/pickup not validated. No Home-area detour. Departure may truncate the exact exit when stopped0..1mm above endpoint with XY/yaw within0.05 and joint checks. User noticed slight pre-entry pause: code queues all3 MoveL calls, final MOVFINISH only; sampled telemetry suggests deceleration at horizontal-to-vertical corner, no programmed wait. Zone=-1 semantics and corner blending not validated; do not silently smooth or alter entrance clearance. Controller startup/reset of jaws requires empty gripper; this trial startup was done empty. Saved logs distinguish rejected preparation and recorder preflight from actual completed motion.

current.title: Hamilton travel and supervised handoffs exist; preserve tip-pair counts
current.body: Supersedes older notes saying the Home-Hamilton route or all loaded handling is missing. The current route is the operator-accepted October26 Home-Hamilton revision; the Oct20 route and handoffs below are historical at the previous station pose, not validation of current pickup/release. Audit session 20261020T121524Z_d37ba039 records completed Hamilton drop-off and pickup/return with both operator inspections accepted. Recovered evidence: reports/hamilton/loaded_handling_history.json; later failed attempts remain in that record. Existing hamilton_dropoff and hamilton_retrieve routines are executable supervised plans starting and finishing Home, available from Hamilton panel buttons and plan_station_handling. Unattended loaded handling and automatic door access remain separately uncommissioned; do not claim those blockers mean no route or no prior successful handoff. For exactly five two-tip pickup/ejection pairs then imaging, preserve ten test tips and one Squid imaging run, with requested calibrations once. Use plan_tip_waste_experiment; native diagnostics consume multiple pairs and have no pair-count parameter. A missing exact-count method blocks execution, not a missing liquid recipe. Calibration consumes additional tips. Do not replace this request with five complete loops, select catalog Protocol, or return the plate to Hamilton after imaging.
current.source: Operator requested recovery from history and clarified exactly five pairs; source audit events and installed Prep OpenAPI, 2026-10-24
